topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the main learning outcomes and contextualizing the material with the histopathology practicals.

topics.label: Tumor virology, proto-oncogene discovery, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Functional classification and dosage of cancer-associated mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the criteria for classifying cancer mutations and demonstrate how pathway regulation and allele dosage alter cellular phenotypes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the underlying repair and segregation defects that generate sequence or chromosomal instability along with their downstream cellular consequences.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sequential mutation accumulation drives tumor progression and how inherited germline defects accelerate cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing with reading recommendations and a look ahead to the next lecture.
